# LC Bridge (Lead Connector Bridge)

> LC Bridge builds products and custom software for HighLevel (GoHighLevel): integrations, marketplace apps, SaaS extensions, AI agents, and frontend experiences.

LC Bridge (Lead Connector Bridge) builds products and provides custom development for the HighLevel / GoHighLevel CRM ecosystem (also searched as "LeadConnector"). Its former HighLevel team members helped design and build APIs used by the developer community. Custom development serves software brands entering the HighLevel market and agencies needing substantial integrations, applications, AI agents, or frontend extensions. LC Bridge is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by HighLevel or DocuSign.

## Custom development

- [GoHighLevel Developers & API Integration Services](https://lcbridge.app/highlevel-development/): GoHighLevel developers for software brands: custom API integrations and middleware, marketplace apps, workflow automation, SaaS and backend extensions, AI agents, and custom JavaScript frontend experiences. The team behind DocuSign Integration and Community Agents. Explore the documented mapping and send flow, and Member Insights. Scope, handover, and support are agreed per engagement. Send a short project brief through the inquiry form; email arun@lcbridge.app is also available.

## Products

- [DocuSign Integration for HighLevel](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/): Send, track, and sync DocuSign e-signature envelopes from inside HighLevel/LeadConnector workflows. Auto-fills documents from contact fields; signed status triggers workflows. White-label, no code.
- [DocuSign workflows for HighLevel](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/workflows): Six pre-built HighLevel workflows for DocuSign contracts, one per moment: send when the deal is ready, make sure it lands, catch them while it's open, chase what stalled, save the declined deal, close the loop when signed. They ship switched off, and every email carries the client sub-account's own branding.
- [Google Sheets Integration for HighLevel](https://lcbridge.app/google-sheets-integration/): Two-way real-time sync between HighLevel contacts/records and Google Sheets. Launching soon; early access open.
- [Community Agents](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/): Released and available now. AI agents for HighLevel communities that answer questions, respond to introductions and wins, and surface possible buying interest with conversation evidence. Configure knowledge and roles, preview responses privately, and choose where agents participate. Keep the default AI disclosure enabled; your team reviews Member Insights and decides how to follow up. Install from HighLevel Marketplace in the owning sub-account, launch through HighLevel authentication, then connect the member portal.

## Community Agents — installation, pricing and guides

- [Docs and guides](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/docs/): Browse installation, portal connection, knowledge, response controls, illustrative use cases, Member Insights, demos, and background reading.

- [Pricing](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/pricing/): $47 USD monthly per HighLevel sub-account, including $47 of AI usage per billing period. Usage is metered at 4× provider cost. Included allowance is used first and expires at renewal; additional usage is billed through the appropriate HighLevel wallet. Agency resale pricing and taxes may change the final charge.
- [Install in HighLevel](https://community-agents.lcbridge.app/oauth/install): Install separately in each sub-account. Launch from HighLevel; no separate Community Agents signup or checkout.
- [Setup guide](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/how-to-add-ai-agent-highlevel-community/): Marketplace installation, member portal, dedicated AI identity, knowledge, preview, and enabled actions.
- [Portal compatibility and GoKollab](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/gokollab-ai-agents/): Member-facing portal and identity access; a public discovery link alone is insufficient.
- [Knowledge and controls](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/knowledge-and-controls/): Prepare knowledge, preview replies, and configure allowed actions. Creating posts is manual; reactions are off by default.
- [Member Insights](https://lcbridge.app/community-agents/member-insights/): Review intent/confidence assessments and source conversations. A person decides whether to follow up.

## DocuSign integration — pricing and contact

- [Pricing](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/pricing): Monthly plans: Starter $29 per active sub-account; Agency $249 for up to 250 sub-accounts; Scale $497 for unlimited sub-accounts. Annual totals: $249 per Starter sub-account, $2,390.40 Agency, $4,771.20 Scale. 14-day trial without a card to start; a separate DocuSign account is required.
- [Book a call](https://lcbridge.app/book-a-call/): Book a 30-minute call with Arun, founder of LC Bridge — about any of the integrations.
- [Book a call](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/book-a-call): Book a 30-minute call with the founder about your HighLevel setup.
- [Documentation](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/): Setup, triggers, field mapping, and how the white-label layer works.
- [Getting started guide](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/getting-started/): Six-minute video walkthrough plus written steps — connect DocuSign, map a template, send an agreement, track it to signature.
- [Workflows setup guide](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/workflows/): Triggers, actions, stall types, merge fields, switch-on order and step-by-step setup for the six contract workflows.

- [Capabilities and requirements](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/features/): Account prerequisites, configuration, branding and PDF access.
- [Field mapping and answer sync](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/field-mapping/): Prefill mapped contact values and return signer-entered answers after completion.
- [Multiple signers](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/docs/multiple-signers/): Select a contact for each recipient role and preview resolved values.
- [Connection methods](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/how-to-integrate): LC Bridge, configured Zapier integration, and manual processes.
- [Native signing comparison](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/vs-native-signature): HighLevel Documents & Contracts and DocuSign support signing; choose by process and account requirements.

## Industry guides

- [DocuSign for Insurance](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/insurance): E-signature workflows for insurance agencies running on HighLevel (applications, ACORD-style forms).
- [DocuSign for Real Estate](https://lcbridge.app/docusign-integration/real-estate): E-signature workflows for real estate teams running on HighLevel (listing and buyer agreements).

## Guides

- [Why your clients still pay for DocuSign](https://lcbridge.app/blog/why-clients-keep-docusign/): For HighLevel agency owners who shipped native Documents & Contracts. Five reasons clients in real estate, insurance and financial services keep DocuSign: the choice belongs to their brokerage or compliance officer, the document leaves the platform, ESIGN 7001(c) consumer disclosure, proving who signed (Ruiz, Espejo, Jones v. Solgen), and years of archives. Sourced, with a disclaimer.
- [The 4 ways a contract stalls](https://lcbridge.app/blog/four-ways-a-contract-stalls/): Sent but not opened, opened but not signed, about to expire, declined. The follow-up each one needs, when to send it, and when to stop.
- [Is a GoHighLevel e-signature legally binding?](https://lcbridge.app/blog/gohighlevel-esignature-legally-binding/): What ESIGN and UETA actually require, the difference between a binding signature and a defensible one (Ruiz v. Moss Bros. vs Espejo), what HighLevel's native signature certificate does and does not capture, and the three situations where a dedicated e-signature platform is genuinely warranted.
- [GoHighLevel Integrations: The Complete Guide](https://lcbridge.app/blog/gohighlevel-integrations/): What GoHighLevel integrations are, native vs Zapier, and the full LC Bridge integration directory for the HighLevel CRM.
- [The 4 Levels of CRM Integration](https://lcbridge.app/blog/four-levels-of-integration/): A See–Know–Do framework for telling a deep, native integration from a Zapier bolt-on. Covers native integration vs Zapier and integration depth.
- [An AI Agent Can't Chase a Signature It Can't See](https://lcbridge.app/blog/ai-agents-need-deep-integrations/): Why AI-agent readiness (agentic CRM, GoHighLevel AI agent) depends on how deep your CRM integrations go.
